findings.title: Snapshot Records actions falsely return not found for entities outside the graph cap
findings.source: Parent scripts/senzing_viz_server.py write_snapshot embedded records index
findings.reason: Byte-identical inherited snapshot implementation, not transformed content.
findings.evidence: write_snapshot :2185 embeds model.graph(cap=GRAPH_NODE_CAP), with cap1500; :2186 embeds all merged entities, and other aggregate lists can refer to entities outside the graph. __recordsFor at:2206–2211 indexes only __DATA__.graph.nodes and returns 'not found: no such entity' otherwise. Synthetic1501entity model: graph1500capped, merges1501; omittedID1501 has live records. Executing the actual generated snapshot shim in Node, without SDK/browser/network, fetch('/api/records?entity_id=1501') returns notfound.
